* **CVE-2026-136716**, Drupal Core: An improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to take over a site via the exposed Drupal installer when the site is in an affected installation state. [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-136716](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-136716), [https://www.drupal.org/sa-core-2026-019](https://www.drupal.org/sa-core-2026-019), [https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
* **CVE-2026-120705**, OSGeo GeoServer: An XML injection vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause the server to read local text files or fetch specified URLs, which can be chained with other vulnerabilities for remote code execution. [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-120705](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-120705), [https://geoserver.org/vulnerability/2026/11/23/cve-update.html](https://geoserver.org/vulnerability/2026/11/23/cve-update.html), [https://github.com/geoserver/geoserver/security/advisories/GHSA-39mw-5chv-jh47](https://github.com/geoserver/geoserver/security/advisories/GHSA-39mw-5chv-jh47)

items.title: Drupal Core Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
items.match_text:
Drupal Core Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
Drupal Core contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to take over a site via the exposed Drupal installer when the site is in one of the affected unusual or incomplete installation states.
Drupal Core

items.title: OSGeo GeoServer XML Injection Vulnerability
items.match_text:
OSGeo GeoServer XML Injection Vulnerability
OsGeo GeoServer contains an XML injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause the server to read local text files accessible to the GeoServer process or fetch attacker-specified HTTP or HTTPS URLs via a crafted ID parameter in the WFS 2.0 GetFeatureById stored query. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-129243, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.
OSGeo GeoServer

items.title: OSGeo GeoServer Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.match_text:
OSGeo GeoServer Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
GeoServer contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass service-level role checks and invoke operations protected solely by those checks via a request with a prefixed service parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-120705, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.
OSGeo GeoServer
